text: High: message bodies, wiki pages, session label/doing and channel topics are inlined raw into MCP results (fmtMsg) and the hook's additionalContext, with no delimiter or untrusted marker; a body with a newline forges a '<michal:czlowiek>' line, the tag agents use to check human approval (AGT-1, AGT-7). Repro s2/inj.test.ts: forged line appears as a separate human message. Fix: escape or indent newlines, wrap in a per-call delimiter labelled untrusted data, say so in both SKILL.md and the hook.
